cards.concept: Stop clustering is market-specific empirical context
cards.definition_principle: Historical evidence of stop-order clustering can motivate a liquidity hypothesis, but CITADEL must not infer actual hidden stops without authoritative order data.
measurable_predicates: trade-through and reclaim or continuation are measured
valid_conditions: The explanation says candidate liquidity location, not observed institutional orders.
failure_conditions: A wick or round number is represented as proof of stop orders.
contradictions: The cited evidence uses one FX dealer dataset and does not reveal NIFTY hidden orders.
when_not_to_use: Do not claim institutional causality or execution intent.
cards.exact_locator: Abstract > order clustering and round numbers
cards.paraphrase: Use clustered-level research only to define measurable candidate locations and disclose hidden-order unavailability.

cards.concept: Liquidity sweep is a measurable price sequence, not hidden-order proof
cards.definition_principle: For CITADEL, a sweep label can mean only a deterministic trade-through and reclaim/acceptance sequence around a prior level; it cannot assert who traded or why.
measurable_predicates: price trades beyond level by tolerance
completed close reclaims or accepts according to versioned rule
failure_conditions: Only a wick, label, or influencer terminology is available.
contradictions: No institutional actor or stop inventory is observed by the candle predicate.
when_not_to_use: Do not make a sweep a standalone reversal signal.
cards.paraphrase: Normalize sweep terminology into a repeatable price predicate and explicitly reject causal claims.

cards.definition_principle: An FVG may be stored only as a versioned three-candle price-gap predicate; institutional imbalance causality and predictive edge remain unvalidated.
measurable_predicates: gap bounds and fill status are numeric
valid_conditions: The card is explanatory or research-only and no authority currently supplies a validated FVG contract.
failure_conditions: The term is used without a numerical definition or as automatic institutional evidence.
contradictions: Different SMC/ICT sources use discretionary variants; no single definition is frozen as objective market truth.
when_not_to_use: Do not use FVG as a target, trigger, or probability in current CITADEL production decisions.
cards.paraphrase: If researched, define the gap mechanically and keep every causal or predictive claim unvalidated.

cards.concept: Order block, BOS, and CHOCH labels require explicit rules
cards.definition_principle: Discretionary SMC labels remain hypotheses until each location, swing rule, close rule, invalidation, and contradiction is deterministic and validated on CITADEL data.
measurable_predicates: swing algorithm and lookback are versioned
break uses completed close and tolerance
zone origin and invalidation are immutable
valid_conditions: Multiple definitions are preserved as competing research specifications.
failure_conditions: One influencer definition is silently treated as institutional truth.
contradictions: Objective implementation removes visual ambiguity but does not create empirical edge.
when_not_to_use: Do not use unvalidated OB/BOS/CHOCH labels in live evidence or execution.
cards.paraphrase: Keep competing deterministic definitions and require OOS CITADEL evidence before any operational use.
